key_facts: Gabriel Bortoleto in car 5 for Audi Revolut F1 Team moved under braking into Turn 5 during the race at the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix.
His car impacted car 43, which had to leave the track as a result.
This movement breached Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 e) of the FIA International Sporting Code, which prohibits moving under braking in a way that impacts another car.
The Stewards issued a Warning (which is equivalent to a black/white flag, a baseline penalty for this type of infringement).
plain_explanation:
Gabriel Bortoleto in car 5 moved his car under braking as he approached Turn 5 during the race at the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix. This caused his car to hit car 43, and car 43 had to leave the track.

The rules say drivers must not move under braking (shift their position while slowing down) in a way that causes an impact with another car. Bortoleto broke this rule. The Stewards reviewed video and in-car camera evidence and decided to issue him a Warning. The document says that a black/white flag (a warning for unsportsmanlike or dangerous driving) is the normal penalty for this kind of infringement, and a Warning is the equivalent to a black/white flag.
